description: This file is a C++ header (.h) for the HdmiCecSink component, defining classes, enums, and function declarations related to HDMI CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) handling within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes class definitions for managing HDMI devices, ports, and processing CEC messages, as well as the main plugin class implementing plugin lifecycle and control methods.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkFrameListener
classes.description: Implements FrameListener to receive CEC frames and forward them to the MessageProcessor.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkProcessor
classes.description: Handles processing of various CEC messages and maintains connection state.

classes.name: CECDeviceParams
classes.description: Holds parameters and state information for a HDMI CEC device.

classes.name: DeviceNode
classes.description: Represents a device node with child logical addresses.

classes.name: HdmiPortMap
classes.description: Represents HDMI port mapping including physical and logical addresses, connection status, and device chain.

classes.name: binary_semaphore
classes.description: Implements a simple binary semaphore for thread synchronization.

classes.name: HdmiCecSink
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI CEC interactions, device management, and communication within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.
